# Lab 20.13: Enforce Binary Authorization on Cloud Run

## What We Are Going to Do
Use the same Binary Authorization policy to block unsigned images on Cloud Run, and require it for every service with an org policy.

## Steps

1. **Push an unsigned image.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export REPO=us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/lab-repo
docker pull us-docker.pkg.dev/cloudrun/container/hello
docker tag us-docker.pkg.dev/cloudrun/container/hello $REPO/hello:v1 &amp;&amp; docker push $REPO/hello:v1
export DIGEST=$(gcloud artifacts docker images describe $REPO/hello:v1 --format="value(image_summary.digest)")</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Deploy with Binary Authorization on.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run deploy binauthz-run --region=us-central1 \
  --image=$REPO/hello@$DIGEST \
  --binary-authorization=default \
  --no-allow-unauthenticated</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The deploy fails because the image has no attestation from `qa-attestor`.

3. **Sign it and deploy again.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud beta container binauthz attestations sign-and-create \
  --artifact-url=$REPO/hello@$DIGEST \
  --attestor=qa-attestor --attestor-project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --keyversion-project=$PROJECT_ID --keyversion-location=global \
  --keyversion-keyring=binauthz-ring --keyversion-key=qa-key --keyversion=1

gcloud run deploy binauthz-run --region=us-central1 \
  --image=$REPO/hello@$DIGEST --binary-authorization=default --no-allow-unauthenticated</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It succeeds.

4. **Require it for all services.** Create `run-binauthz.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/policies/run.allowedBinaryAuthorizationPolicies
spec:
  rules:
  - values:
      allowedValues:
      - default</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud org-policies set-policy run-binauthz.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Deploying any service without `--binary-authorization=default` now fails.

5. **Find the decisions in the logs.** Search Logs Explorer for `binaryauthorization` to see allowed and denied deploys.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud run services delete binauthz-run --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud org-policies delete run.allowedBinaryAuthorizationPolicies --project=$PROJECT_ID
cat &gt; allow-all.yaml &lt;&lt;EOF
globalPolicyEvaluationMode: ENABLE
defaultAdmissionRule:
  evaluationMode: ALWAYS_ALLOW
  enforcementMode: ENFORCED_BLOCK_AND_AUDIT_LOG
EOF
gcloud container binauthz policy import allow-all.yaml</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Unsigned image | Deploy rejected |
| Signed image | Deploy succeeds |
| Org policy | Every service must use Binary Authorization |
| Same policy | Shared by GKE and Cloud Run in the project |
